$comment: A labelled corpus for scripts/calibrate.mjs, which measures what
verify-min-confidence actually buys instead of assuming 60 is a number.
Every case replaces test-fixture/app.js and EVERY case passes `npm test`.
That is the whole design. A wrong migration that fails the tests is already
caught by the test re-run, for free, before a reviewer is ever paid - so it
tells you nothing about the reviewer. The population the threshold is applied
to is exactly this one: changes that pass, half of them right and half wrong.
`why` is the ground truth, written down before any model saw the diff. It is
never shown to the reviewer - the reviewer gets the diff, the test output and
the changelog, the same evidence a real run gives it.
